metadata.description: Session lifecycle tools for Claude Code: revive after the 5-hour and weekly limits, hand off to a fresh session before the context fills, split planned work across Opus and Sonnet subagents

plugins.name: limit-revive
plugins.description: Auto-resume a session after the 5-hour or weekly usage limit resets, only when work is unfinished; stop at the weekly threshold when its reset is far away.

plugins.name: context-handoff
plugins.description: Past a context-fill threshold, have Claude write a handoff file and continue in a fresh session on the same model in auto mode.

plugins.name: subagentify
plugins.description: When Claude plans, split the work into subagents and run each on Opus or Sonnet as the task requires.
